tools_helpful.evidence: Namespace mass-rewrite (Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml) and per-file TODO injection let the agent produce a clean-building 13-scenario app that scored 100.

tool_limitations.limitation: MRT Core programmatic API (Windows.ApplicationModel.Resources.Core: ResourceManager.Current / ResourceContext / ResourceMap) is not in the 'adaptable' inventory, so no TODO[migrate] marker was injected on those lines and the agent copied the UWP namespace verbatim.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add an 'adaptable' inventory entry routing the MRT Core namespace/types to a 'resources' anchor.

doc_errors.wrong: Section documented only ResourceLoader.GetForCurrentView() -> new ResourceLoader(); it did not cover ResourceManager.Current / ResourceContext.GetForViewIndependentUse / ResourceMap.GetValue, which is the API this scenario actually uses.
doc_errors.correct: ResourceManager.Current -> new ResourceManager(); ResourceContext.GetForViewIndependentUse()/GetForCurrentView() -> manager.CreateResourceContext(); ResourceMap.GetValue -> TryGetValue; namespace Windows.ApplicationModel.Resources.Core -> Microsoft.Windows.ApplicationModel.Resources.

special_apis.special_handling: MRT Core only pre-populates the Language qualifier; other qualifiers (e.g. Scale) must be set manually via ctx.QualifierValues[...]; there is no SetGlobalQualifierValue and the current-view/view-independent distinction is gone.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Migrated scenario code retained the UWP MRT namespace and static ResourceManager.Current / ResourceContext factory calls; the WindowsAppSDK analyzer flags this as UWP-only API residue.
errors_encountered.fix: Switch to Microsoft.Windows.ApplicationModel.Resources: new ResourceManager(), manager.CreateResourceContext(), map.TryGetValue(...).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Left 'using Windows.ApplicationModel.Resources.Core;' and ResourceManager.Current/ResourceContext usage in place; build produced 5 WUI1001 warnings (UWP residue) though it compiled and ran.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: not iterated on (agent never surfaced WUI1001 in the log)
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: No TODO[migrate] marker was injected on those lines (API absent from the inventory) AND the #resources doc section only covered ResourceLoader, so the agent had no signal or mapping for the MRT Core ResourceManager/ResourceContext family.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved during the trial (residue shipped; scorer reconciled functionality as pass).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Add the MRT Core namespace/types to unsupported-api-inventory.json 'adaptable' (routes to a #resources TODO) and expand MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md #resources to map ResourceManager/ResourceContext/ResourceMap.
